title: Balsamic Steak and Artichoke Farro Bowls
intro: Most bistros serve steak with heavy fries, but pairing it with hearty farro and fiber-rich artichokes creates a more balanced meal.

ingredients.name: Lean sirloin steak strips
ingredients.canonical_name: Beef, top sirloin, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, raw

ingredients.name: Canned artichoke hearts (in water, no-salt-added)
ingredients.canonical_name: Artichokes (globe or french), canned, no salt added, drained

ingredients.name: Cherry tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

instructions: Whisk the balsamic vinegar, olive oil, Dijon mustard, garlic powder, and black pepper in a large mixing bowl to create a dressing.
Add the artichoke hearts, cherry tomatoes, and arugula to the bowl. Toss to coat, then divide the salad mixture into serving bowls.
Heat the farro according to the pouch instructions. Spoon the warm grain over the salad bases.
Pat the steak strips dry with a paper towel. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the steak in a single layer. Sear for 4 to 6 minutes, flipping halfway through, until browned.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let the meat rest in the pan to retain its juices.
Top each bowl with the rested steak strips and serve immediately.
variation: Swap the sirloin steak strips for boneless, skinless chicken breast.
conservation: Keeps 2 days refrigerated; pack the steak and farro separately.
